summary: CID HoldCo filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a second required subsequent closing under a note purchase agreement with White Lion Capital on May 29, 2026. The company issued a $287,500 face amount senior secured convertible promissory note for $230,000 in cash (20% original issue discount). The note, bearing 8% interest and maturing in six months, is convertible into common stock at a variable conversion price (80% of lowest VWAP over 15 days). Proceeds are applied to monthly payments under a prior note with J.J. Astor Co. A 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker applies. Watch for dilution risk given the variable conversion structure and potential trading mechanics.
